Name: Better Crystalarium
Author: DeyvidMods
Description:
Better Crystalarium improves the Crystalarium while keeping its original behavior simple and familiar.

FEATURES

• 3x Faster Production
All Crystalarium production times are reduced to one third of their original duration. The speed multiplier is fixed at 3x and requires no configuration.

• Preserves Item Quality
If an item with Silver, Gold, or Iridium quality is placed in a Crystalarium, the duplicated item keeps the same quality as the original.

• Compatible With Additional Crystalarium Items
Better Crystalarium does not use its own list of allowed items. If Stardew Valley or another mod allows an item to be placed in a Crystalarium, Better Crystalarium automatically applies the 3x production speed to it.

This means the mod can also work with items that aren't normally accepted by the vanilla Crystalarium, as long as another installed mod enables them.

• Automatic Repeat Cycles
The 3x speed is correctly applied again when the Crystalarium starts its next production cycle after you collect an item.

• Safe Across Saves and Reloads
Production progress is preserved when saving, returning to the title screen, or completely restarting the game. The speed multiplier isn't applied repeatedly when loading a save.

HOW IT WORKS

Better Crystalarium doesn't replace the Crystalarium's production rules or decide what it can duplicate. It uses the production time already assigned by the game or another mod and reduces that time to one third.

For example:

7 hours → 2 hours 20 minutes
21 days → 7 days

INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Extract Better Crystalarium into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

No configuration is required.

COMPATIBILITY

Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI.

Better Crystalarium is designed to remain compatible with mods that expand the items accepted by the Crystalarium. Those mods remain responsible for deciding which items can be duplicated; Better Crystalarium only improves the production speed and preserves item quality.

MULTIPLAYER

The mod should be installed by all players for consistent behavior.
